evidence.quote: Each quota applies to all requests for these operations in the AWS account and Region with the given key type in each one-second interval.
All AWS KMS request quotas are adjustable, except for the AWS CloudHSM key store request quota.
Throttling is based on all requests on KMS keys of all types in the Region. This total includes requests from all principals in the AWS account, including requests from AWS services on your behalf.
